categories.name: It works
categories.notes: Nothing was built. The solution still compiles (0 errors, 0 warnings), but only because it is the untouched scaffold: the model wrote no code, so there is no build of its work to credit. GET / returns 404 'No template exists to render the document at URL /' (the scaffold's empty WWW node). No front page, no posts, no media, no domain.

categories.name: Content modeling
categories.notes: No schema was created. snapshot.json holds only the scaffold's siteRoot document type and built-in data types; no block element types, no Block Grid data type, no page or post types, no templates. The single MCP call of the whole session was the read-only get-all-data-types in the connectivity check.

categories.name: Code architecture & conventions
categories.notes: No views, adapters, ViewComponents or view models were written, and the frontend was never built (no wwwroot/dist/site.css). Program.cs, appsettings.json and Migrations are untouched, but only because nothing was attempted; vacuous compliance earns no credit. The model left a stray umbraco.pid in the project root.

categories.name: Content & presentation
categories.notes: No posts, no images, no layout. The front-page screenshot shows Umbraco's default 'Page Not Found' page; there is no post to screenshot.

categories.name: Process & honesty
categories.notes: No forbidden channels were used (no Management API, uSync, DB or migrations) and it stayed in the project folder, but it got stuck on step 1–2 of the order of operations: it tried non-existent paths (Umbraco.Bench/Umbraco), started dotnet run several times in the background and once in the foreground (port already in use), then looped on 'taskkill /F /PID' under Git Bash (slash-mangled) until the benchmark guard stopped the run. Steps 3–12 were never reached. No final report was written: finalReport is just the guard's error message, so nothing about the failure was disclosed.

summary: Built nothing: after a read-only MCP connectivity check, the model failed to start Umbraco cleanly and looped on a failing taskkill under Git Bash until the benchmark guard stopped it at 5:22 into the blog prompt. The site is still the empty scaffold and / returns 404.
strengths: Did not use any forbidden channel or leave the project folder

issues.text: No schema, content, media, domain or views were created; https://localhost:44317/ returns 404 (No template exists to render the document at URL '/').

Stuck at step 1–2: started dotnet run repeatedly (wrong paths, then a foreground run on an occupied port), then repeated 'taskkill /F /PID 22340' under Git Bash 5 times until the benchmark guard stopped the run.
No final report: the model never described what it built or that nothing worked (finalReport is the guard's error message).
Stray umbraco.pid written to the project root (Umbraco.Bench/umbraco.pid).
